statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: More than 100 rural hospitals in this country closed down since ObamaCare upended healthcare in America 16 years ago.
It was part of the working families tax cuts law that we passed last summer.
One of the radical incoming Democrat Senators declared: Medicare for All, he said, guarantees you a public healthcare plan and eliminates your private one.
We will strengthen and expand access to medical care in every corner of the State.

People remember that that is the statement that one of the national newspapers called the ``Lie of the Year.'' Now, a radical incoming Democrat is promising: If you like your healthcare plan, we are going to take it away from you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION

Even some very liberal climate groups are urging swift passage.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: The Senate Judiciary Committee is indispensable for vetting and advancing conservative judges, and Senator Grassley is pursuing a bold confirmation schedule.
We are going to confirm four more judges this week.
We will leave no vacancy behind.

statements.title: Legislative Agenda (Executive Session)
sentences: We are going to do it right here in the U.S. Senate.
We will confirm dozens of conservative Federal judges to the courts.
We will confirm many qualified nominees to positions in the Federal Government.
We will pass historic permitting legislation and reform.
We will never apologize for our conservative convictions.
We will leave no vacancy behind.
We will complete a final nominations package before the end of the year and will get them all confirmed.

statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: It is one of the features of the Democrat Green New Deal, their agenda, to keep the energy, American energy, in the ground.
Senator Husted's bill guarantees that large users of energy, of electricity such as data centers, that they would end up paying the full cost of their electricity use, not the consumers.
Democrats would have snatched hard-earned money away and right out of the pockets of our firefighters, police officers, nurses, and waiters.
We eliminated tax on Social Security.
We delivered permanent relief--you know about this as do I, in my home State, from the dreaded death tax.
As a result of the Working Families Tax Cuts law, 97 percent of Americans received a tax cut when they filed their tax return last year.
It identified three-quarters of a million names--not necessarily people but names--that were fraudulent, improper, and ineligible for ObamaCare.
Many of these names didn't even have a Social Security number associated with it.
Enrollment doubled under ObamaCare on their watch without justification and often falsehoods.
Perverse incentives encouraged liberal Governors to spend money from Medicaid without any oversight.
They want to raise taxes on waitresses, on nurses working overtime, on firefighters, on police officers, and on our seniors.
They said so they can provide healthcare for illegal immigrants with taxpayers paying for it.
Americans shouldn't be paying the bills for millions of illegal immigrants.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: As Democrat climate alarmists forced the closure of our coal-fired powerplants, China built new ones.
They continue to build them today in the race for power and the competition over artificial intelligence.
A secure border means less fentanyl coming through China, through Mexico and the southern border into the United States.
No longer can China buy oil at steep discounts from dictatorships in Venezuela or Iran.
The President has now signed into legislation the Lindsey Graham bill, putting new penalties on China for importing oil and energy from Russia or from Iran.
The United States is systematically blocking the vast ambitions of the so-called axis of aggression--China, Russia, and Iran.
The antitrust laws applied to the collegiate sports system are currently the reason why sports are governed by court order rather than by fair, enforceable rules for all.
The Protect College Sports Act provides the NCAA with the ability to govern, but any antitrust protection is narrow, and it comes with guardrails.
We will finish that bill this week and send it to the House and then, hopefully, on to the President for his signature.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: The Democrat nominee in Michigan wants to take away our guns, our Second Amendment rights.
What is truly problematic is that thousands of illegal immigrants were registered to vote in your State of New Jersey.
Additionally, the Democrat manifesto calls for abolishing the Supreme Court--a Supreme Court as appointed by the President and confirmed by this body, the Senate.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: President Trump ended Joe Biden's so-called Clean Power Plan 2.0.
Last year, Republicans in Congress used the Congressional Review Act many times to overturn California's ban on a number of things, and one specifically was gas-powered vehicles.
So Democrats want to use them to set new rules to force-feed electric vehicles all across the country.

So what we have here in the Senate is we have Senator Ricketts and Senator Husted having resolutions to repeal these California nationwide mandates for electric vehicles that the Democrats have been trying to pedal since the Obama years.
When it comes to electric vehicles, the American people have been voting with their wallets.
We have seen the sale of electric vehicles down 20 percent in the last year.
We are unlocking American energy, as we need to do, and we are fighting for America's energy workers.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Wyoming (Executive Session)
statements.title: Wyoming (Executive Session)
sentences: Taxes on tips, taxes on overtime, taxes on Social Security, they are all gone now.
The crooks and the criminals that we know have been abusing Medicaid and abusing food stamps--today, they are paying the price; they are being held to account.

The Democrat nominee for the Senate in Minnesota claims Immigration and Customs Enforcement, she says, is evil, and she wants to ``rip ICE apart.'' The Democrat nominee in Maine, he wants free healthcare for every illegal immigrant in the country.
The Democrat nominee in Texas says he would lay out a welcome mat at the southern border.
They want to shut down police.
Democrats want to start taxing tips and overtime and Social Security.
That is a direct increase in taxes on waiters and waitresses, on police officers, on nurses.
It is a direct increase in taxes on our seniors if they start taxing Social Security, which is what they want to do.
They want to use it to pay for healthcare for illegal immigrants.
People in my home State of Wyoming I talked to don't want to defund the police; they don't want to defund the military.
People I talked to at home, they don't want to put a welcome mat out at the southern border.
The people I talked to at home don't want hard-working Americans to be forced to pay for healthcare for illegal immigrants.
The people I talked to at home don't believe illegal immigrants should have the right to vote or to be made citizens.
We cannot allow that to become the future for our Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Republican Party Accomplishments (Executive Session)
statements.title: Republican Party Accomplishments (Executive Session)
sentences: He actually called it ``disastrous.'' Ninety-seven percent of Americans benefited from the Working Families Tax Cuts law.
People on Social Security know it.
One resident of Nevada recently said: I received the largest tax return in my entire life this year.
Democrats wanted people on Social Security to pay more in taxes.
More than 60 million Americans benefited from the new tax benefits since Republicans passed the Working Families Tax Cuts law.
I also want to talk about the border because today our Nation's immigration laws are being strongly enforced.
National security begins with border security.
Absolutely zero illegal immigrants have been released into our country in over 14 months--absolutely zero--because Republicans have ended the reckless Joe Biden catch-and-release program.

Hundreds of thousands of illegal-immigrant criminals have now been arrested and deported since President Trump took office, and we are seeing the most secure border and the most successful deportation operation in all of American history.
This year, Republicans also passed the Secure America Act.
This law ensures that immigration officials have the resources that they need to keep our country safe and to keep our communities safe for years to come.
Congress also passed the first major digital asset bill in American history; it is called the GENIUS Act.
It is time for the Senate to build on that by passing the Clarity Act.
Their manifesto wants to defund the police.
We are going to continue to fight for that.
Very soon, we will confirm an additional 74 nominees.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Democrat Party (Executive Session)
statements.title: Democrat Party (Executive Session)
sentences: The driving force in the Democrat Party is calling to defund the police.
The driving force in the Democrat Party is calling to eliminate Immigration and Customs Enforcement in this country.
Democrats want to go back to the dangerous Biden years when it comes to protecting our borders, and 10 million illegal immigrants flooded into this country.
Well, the Democrats want to have hard-working taxpayers pay for healthcare for all the illegal immigrants who come here.
We are going to continue to fight the extremists, and we are going to continue to fight for freedom, for liberty, and for continued American greatness.

statements.title: AGOA EXTENSION ACT--Motion to Proceed
sentences: Democrats voted to defund America's law enforcement Agencies.
That seems to be their mantra: defund the police; get rid of ICE, get rid of Immigration and Customs Enforcement; open the borders; let anybody in.
By shutting down the Department of Homeland Security, Democrats put the safety of illegal immigrants--and specifically illegal immigrant criminals--above the safety and security of American citizens.
We will see what the Democrats say today.

sentences: She said, ``True.'' She was asked whether they want to replace the Presidency and the Supreme Court.

She said, ``Absolutely.'' She was asked whether they want to abolish borders and give amnesty to every illegal immigrant in America, including illegal immigrant criminals.

The same radical agenda that targets America also targets our closest ally, Israel.
One of the leaders of this anti-Israel campaign is the current mayor of New York City.
He has called for the arrest of Israel's Prime Minister.
The liberal, extreme mayor of New York City wants to hand over the Prime Minister of Israel to an unaccountable group called the International Criminal Court.
In its 24 years of existence, it has never charged a single leader of Iran for Iran's atrocities against the world.
The United States is not a member of the so-called International Criminal Court nor is Israel.
They want to weaken our military and abandon Israel.
Republicans will never allow America to become a sanctuary country.
No State will lose its equal voice without its consent, and we will not silence the voice of the people who we represent.

sentences: This is the way Russia is financing its brutal killing war in Ukraine.
We know that energy is a cash cow of Putin's war machine.
Next is India, and they are going to be hit hard by this.
Allies of Ukraine can qualify for exemptions.
For many years--and you and I have talked about this--Europe has spent more money on Russian energy than it has sent in aid to Ukraine.
Of course, Russia isn't fighting Ukraine alone.
In Putin's war of aggression, it is Iran partnering with Russia.
Iran has supplied Russia with drones, with missiles, with munitions.
Russia has used these weapons to kill Ukrainian civilians and to destroy Ukrainian infrastructure.
In return, Russia has shared with Iran--we know what they have shared with their regime: technology, intelligence, military support, all of those things.
Iran has used this support to attack American troops.
And we have seen the attacks on the American troops that hold the area in terms of how Iran holds the Strait of Hormuz hostage.
Russia and Iran both employ a shadow fleet of illegal oil tankers.
That is why Iran has rightfully been added to this sanctions bill.
Lindsey started it about Russia, and now we have added Iran with President Trump's guidance.
Together, Russia and Iran have built an ``axis of aggression,'' and we know where the aggression is headed.
Sanctioning those who buy oil from Russia and Iran disrupts this entire axis all at once.
Senator Graham visited Ukraine shortly before he died.
Lindsey was a friend of freedom in Ukraine.
Today, Russia is at the point of maximum weakness, and so is Iran.
At the same time, Iran's military has been severely degraded.
Both Russia and Iran still refuse to accept plans for lasting peace.
Russia and Iran respond only to strength, not to statements.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: In big cities and blue States, illegal immigrants are registering to vote and are casting ballots.
This week, the State of New Jersey admitted that 6,600 noncitizens made it onto their voting rolls.
Here is how it happened: For 4 years, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris flung open our southern border, and 10 million illegal immigrants flooded into our country.
Among them were criminals, members of cartels, drug dealers, gang members, and terror suspects.
Sanctuary States and cities welcomed these illegal immigrants, and the State of New Jersey, where all of this happened, is one of them.
New Jersey hands out driver's licenses to illegal immigrants.
Its department of motor vehicles turns driver's licenses directly into voter registration.
And in this case, the State of New Jersey, it registered 6,600 of these illegal immigrants to vote.
The real blame belongs to the Democrats and their sanctuary city and State policies.
Democrats can't throw open the borders, hand illegal immigrants driver's licenses, and then pretend to be shocked--shocked--the Democrats claim to be when these illegal immigrants end up voting.
Illegal immigrants must not be allowed to vote in American elections.
The National Voter Registration Act requires States to make ``reasonable efforts'' to maintain accurate voter rolls.

Just moments ago, right before he left the floor, he talked about so-called ``Democrats election integrity task force''--I wrote it down as he said it-- ``Democrats election integrity task force.'' You talk about an oxymoron--like jumbo shrimp, like pretty ugly, like deafening silence.
Democrats need to stop opposing every effort we make on this Senate floor to secure our border and to enforce our immigration laws.
Election security begins with border security.
Today's Democrats want neither border security nor election security.
And they sure don't want voter ID.
They don't want to have it guaranteed that only citizens vote.
In Michigan, a leading Democrat candidate for this U.S. Senate has been fighting since 2018--we are talking 8 years--to abolish ICE.
Eight years spent fighting our Nation's Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
They want mass amnesty for illegal immigrants, and that includes illegal immigrant criminals, even murderers.
Then the Democrats are demanding free healthcare for illegal immigrants paid for by American taxpayers.
They are demanding illegal immigrants vote in our elections.
They want to pack the Supreme Court.
They want to abolish the electoral college.
The Department of Homeland Security recently released new data about the number of illegal border crossings in the month of June.
For the past 14 months, zero illegal immigrants have been released into the country--absolutely zero--after millions and millions and millions under the Joe Biden catch-and-release disaster.
Republicans have secured the border, but this fight isn't over.
After years of Democrat open border policies, millions of illegal immigrants remain in our country today.
Republicans promised to deport illegal immigrant criminals, and it is time to continue on with that promise.
The American people rejected open borders before and will reject them again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Working Families Tax Cut Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: Working Families Tax Cut Act (Executive Session)
sentences: The Working Families Tax Cut law made that happen.
Americans already filed their taxes this year, and working families are keeping more of what they earned, and the data proves it.
These are firefighters, police officers, and nurses.

Now what we see is that extremist Democrats in Governor mansions across the country and State legislatures are trying to undermine the Working Families Tax Cut law, and they are doing it in city halls and in State capitals.
The city council of Washington, DC, refused to allow the hard-working waiters, bartenders, police officers, and firefighters to keep that hard-earned money.
Democrats want to take more money out of your pocket to give free healthcare to illegal immigrants.
And that is what we see in so many of these States with sanctuary cities, sanctuary States--free healthcare.
It is people going to work every day and having their tax dollars taken to pay for healthcare for illegal immigrants.
Their manifesto includes mass amnesty, open borders, and elimination of Immigration and Customs Enforcement in the country.
Working families are overtaxed, and fraud is out of control.
Just yesterday, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services stopped more than $1 billion in Medicaid funding from going to California and Minnesota.
I support what Senator Ernst is doing.

Democrats voted to defund Immigration and Customs Enforcement, and they voted to defund our Border Patrol.
We will see if the Democrats are willing to meet us along the way.

Well, because New York Democrats--pressured by climate extremists--shut down reliable nuclear powerplants.

We fully funded ICE and Border Patrol for the next 3 years, and we are deporting illegal immigrant criminals.
The contrast is clear: Democrats stand for high taxes, open borders, and lawlessness.

statements.title: National Defense Authorization Act (Executive Session)
sentences: Democrats voted against ending harmful DEI mandates.
They voted against stronger border security.
They don't want border security.
They voted against funding to combat against the cartels that are moving poison into the country--killing young people in record numbers.
Democrats voted against stopping the flood of deadly drugs and illegal border crossings.

Just 2 days ago, right here on the Senate floor, the Senator from Maryland, Senator Chris Van Hollen, said this: Missile defense--to defend against incoming missiles for the American people--was wasteful spending.
Defending the country is wasteful spending.

The Democrats act like pennypinchers when it comes to paying our troops to protect our homeland; yet, they accept the astronomical cost of the waste, the fraud, and the abuse--free healthcare for illegal immigrants, the fraud that is happening like we are seeing in Minnesota, and all of those things.
I am going to go through the list of all the things they said no to yesterday.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Rural Healthcare (Executive Session)
statements.title: Rural Healthcare (Executive Session)
sentences: ObamaCare accelerated the rural healthcare crisis with there being hospitals closing all across the country.
Since ObamaCare became law 15 years ago, over 100 rural hospitals across our Nation have closed.
It is yet another broken promise from the failure of the Obama healthcare law, known as ObamaCare.
The Rural Health Transformation Fund is a crucial piece of the Working Families Tax Cut law.
You know, Dr. Oz leads the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.
It is because they wanted to pay for healthcare for illegal immigrants.
Look at what happened in New York yesterday with the primary elections: open borders, eliminate ICE, focus on giving services to illegal immigrants--people who are in the country illegally.
Democrats voted to weaken healthcare for law-abiding American citizens in order to expand healthcare for illegal immigrants.
It is not necessarily healthcare for you or your family; it is healthcare for illegal immigrants.
Republicans are reversing the damage done by ObamaCare which, to repeat, forced the closure of over 100 small community hospitals around the country.
We are supporting rural hospitals and clinics.
Republicans are putting rural communities first, and we are going to continue to do that.

statements.title: ENERGY

Today, I want to talk about the impact of the Working Families Tax Cut law on American energy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Republicans passed the Working Families Tax Cut law to promote the American dream.
The Working Families Tax Cut law put more money into their pockets.
Republicans cut taxes for working families all across America.
They can use it to pay down debt, to cover everyday expenses, or to save for the future.
Every single Democrat in this Chamber--every single one of them-- voted against the Working Families Tax Cut law.
At the State of the Union, Americans heard the story of a mother who homeschools two children during the day, and in the evening, she goes out and waits tables.
The Working Families Tax Cut law was written for families like theirs.
Well, no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and the expanded child tax credit--all three of those advantages passed in the Working Families Tax Cut law.
The Working Families Tax Cut law helps families today, and it builds more opportunities for families tomorrow.

statements.title: Wildfires (Executive Session)
sentences: Without proper forest management, we are going to continue to see costly and deadly wildfires.
That is exactly why I introduced the Wildfire Prevention Act.
We can't allow a Washington mandate imposed on States, a quarter of a century ago, to continue to undermine our ability to manage our forests.

statements.title: FRAUD
sentences: Republicans passed the Working Families Tax Cut law.
We strengthened eligibility requirements for Medicaid.
We ensured that illegal immigrants did not receive taxpayer-funded healthcare.
We put in place work requirements for Medicaid and for food stamps.

Dr. Oz runs the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid, confirmed here by the Senate.
In Ohio, the anti-fraud task force dismantled a criminal scheme that stole tens of millions of dollars from Medicaid.
Thankfully, Senator Jon Husted and Senator Bernie Moreno of Ohio voted for the Working Families Tax Cut law.

Nationwide, total estimates of Medicaid fraud are as much as now $120 billion a year, and the fraud got worse after ObamaCare became law: bigger government, more money, more areas in which criminals can steal.
Vice President Vance is encouraging States to fight fraud in their Medicaid Programs.
Appallingly, we have seen cases where Democrats actually tried to silence whistleblowers, who sound the alarm to try to want to point out what is happening.
We are fighting to protect taxpayers, to protect vulnerable families, and fighting to punish the criminals who steal from our country and our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUT ACT
statements.title: WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUT ACT
sentences: Mr. President, the Working Families Tax Cut law has put more money in people's pockets and pocketbooks.
Working families kept more of the money that they had earned.
Thirty-five million Americans benefited from the senior deduction on Social Security--average deduction there $7,500.
Some of the biggest benefits of the Working Families Tax Cut law are still ahead.
That is why we have created Trump accounts as part of the Working Families Tax Cut law.
In Wyoming, I am grateful that the cryptocurrency exchange Kraken has committed to make a contribution to the Trump account for every child born in Wyoming this year.

So imagine this, years from now your son or daughter walks into the bank and they use their Trump account to put the downpayment on their first home or your son or daughter starts that small business they have been dreaming about using the Trump account or they simply let the investment continue to grow until they retire.
It is one of the important prospects for the future that we foresaw and put into the Working Families Tax Cut law that every Democrat voted against.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECOGNITION OF THE MAJORITY LEADER
statements.title: RECOGNITION OF THE MAJORITY LEADER
sentences: For months, the Democrats have refused to fund law enforcement activities in this Nation, things we need to keep our borders secure and to keep our communities safe.
Month after month after month, Democrats have refused to fund law enforcement activities that keep our borders secure and that keep our communities safe.
I am, therefore, going to vote no, and I urge each of my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BORDER SECURITY
statements.title: BORDER SECURITY
sentences: Mr. President, Republicans are ready to move forward on funding critical components of our government--Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Border Patrol.

What we are proposing and the bill that we will be discussing today is a bill that is targeted and focused, and it is a vote for safe communities, not for criminals--specifically, criminal illegal aliens.
It seems it is to defund border security, defund law enforcement in this country.

sentences: BACKGROUND BLM Public Land Management Under the Federal Land Policy and Management Act of 1976, as amended (FLPMA), BLM is responsible for developing, maintaining, and, when appropriate, revising ``land use plans which provide by tracts or areas for the use of the public lands.'' BLM land use plans, referred to as ``resource management plans'' (RMPs), establish goals and directives to guide future land and resource management actions implemented by BLM.

An RMP generally establishes land use designations; allowable resource uses; resource conditions, goals, and objectives; program constraints and general management practices; areas to be covered by more specific plans; and other related information.

In its order, the court directed BLM to consider no coal leasing and limited coal leasing alternatives and to disclose the public health impacts, both climate and non-climate, of burning fossil fuels from the planning area.

Finally, the Buffalo RMPA implements, interprets, or prescribes law or policy, because it designates which areas of BLM-administered land are available for coal leasing consideration in accordance with BLM's responsibilities for land use management under FLPMA.
Specifically, the Buffalo RMPA designated approximately 48.12 billion short tons of coal as unavailable for further leasing consideration to help reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Our conclusion here is consistent with our previous decisions finding similar land use plans and RMPs implement, interpret, or prescribe law or policy.

For example, in B-337163, June 25, 2025, we concluded that BLM's Miles City Resource Management Plan Amendment (Miles City RMPA) implemented law and prescribed policy by foreclosing coal leasing on BLM-administered land pursuant to its duties under FLPMA and other applicable statutes to manage land use and the government's mineral resources.

Similarly in B- 337200, June 25, 2025, we concluded that an RMP issued by BLM implemented law and prescribed policy by designating or foreclosing specific activities or land use on BLM- administered land within its Central Yukon planning area (Central Yukon RMP).
Like the Miles City RMPA and the Central Yukon RMP, the Buffalo RMPA carries out BLM's legal mandates related to land use planning and resource allocation.

For example, in B-337163, June 25, 2025, BLM issued the Miles City RMPA that established land use designations to govern all coal activities by any person or entity within the planning area of its Miles City Field Office.

Similarly, the Buffalo RMPA establishes land use designations that prohibit coal leasing by any person or entity within the Buffalo planning area, making it a rule of general applicability. (2) Rule of Agency Management or Personnel The Buffalo RMPA is not a rule of agency management or personnel.

For instance, in B-329926, Sept. 10, 2018, we found that updates to a Social Security Administration (SSA) hearing manual governing SSA adjudicators' use of information from the Internet qualified as a rule of agency organization, procedure, or practice.

Similarly, in B-337200, June 25, 2025, we declined to apply CRA's third exception to the Central Yukon RMP because it foreclosed certain actions by non-agency entities, through the establishment of land use designations and delineation of the activities that may be undertaken in the planning area.

Similarly, in B-337200, June 25, 2025, we concluded that the Central Yukon RMP substantially affected non-agency parties by imposing, among other things, land use restrictions, such as designating areas of critical environmental concern and closing certain tracts for land for mineral extraction and recreational use.

Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Health and Human Services shall issue and disseminate guidance to States on strategies to overcome existing barriers to coverage of services furnished by advanced psychology trainees (as defined under section 1861(ii)(2) of the Social Security Act, as added by section 2(a), through the Medicaid program under title XIX of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396 et seq.) and the Children's Health Insurance Program under title XXI of such Act (42 U.S.C. 1397aa et seq.)).

Such guidance shall include technical assistance and best practices regarding each of the following: (1) Recommended legal mechanisms for activating coverage of services furnished by advanced psychology trainees under such programs. statements.title: Medicaid (Executive Session)
